title: Vulnetix config: shared definitions
description: Definitions every Vulnetix config kind refers to. Not a document kind itself.

apiVersion.description: The document format version. Every kind in this release is vulnetix.com/v1.

name.description: The object's name, unique per kind within a tenant. It is the natural key: plan, apply, export and the Terraform provider all address an object by kind and name.

org.description: The tenant (organization UUID) the document belongs to. When set, plan and apply refuse to run against any other tenant.

labels.description: Free key/value labels. Stored with the object, never interpreted by the server.

annotations.description: Free key/value notes for people and tools, such as a ticket link.

singletonMetadata.description: Metadata for a kind the tenant has exactly one of. The name is fixed to default.

valueFrom.description: Where a client reads a secret value. The value is resolved on the machine running the client, sent once, and never exported or shown in a plan.

file.description: Path to a file holding the value. Trailing newlines are trimmed.

celExpression.description: A CEL expression (https://cel.dev) returning bool. The variables it may use depend on where it appears; each kind's reference lists them. Plan type-checks the expression.

purl.description: A package URL (https://github.com/package-url/purl-spec). Omit the version to mean every version.

vexJustification.description: Why a vulnerability does not affect a product, in the OpenVEX 0.2.0 vocabulary. CycloneDX VEX justifications map onto these.

legacySingletonMetadata.description: Metadata for a singleton kind whose documents predate metadata.name. Both metadata and its name may be left out; a name, when given, must be default.

timestamp.description: A point in time: an RFC 3339 date-time (2026-12-31T17:00:00Z), or a date (2026-12-31), read as midnight UTC at the start of that day.

repository.description: A repository by its full name, owner/name as the forge shows it. Nested groups (group/subgroup/name) are allowed.

vaultRef.description: The metadata.name of a VaultEntry holding a credential. The value is read from the tenant's vault when it is needed and is never copied into the referring object.

capabilityGlob.description: A name, or a glob in which only * is special (mcp__github__*). It matches the whole name: anchors are implied, so a leading ^ or a trailing $ would be matched literally and is refused.

messagingConnectionRef.description: The metadata.name of a MessagingConnection. The server resolves it to the connection's id, which must belong to the tenant.

configFile.description: A file the client reads and sends as the value, relative to the config root. The server never reads a path.

aiCapabilityList.description: An allow or deny list for one AI capability family. Each pattern becomes one AI Firewall guardrail row of rule type <family>_<list> (tool_deny, mcp_allow and so on). A deny always wins. Any enabled allow rule puts its family into allowlist mode, where everything it does not name is refused.

family.description: tool: a tool offered to the model. mcp: an MCP server wired into the session. skill: an agent skill. client: the calling client, named by its headers (claude-code, codex-cli).

action.description: block refuses the request. flag lets it through and records the match. strip removes the matched tool or MCP server and sends the rest of the request; it applies to the tool and mcp families only, because a skill is a value inside another tool and a client is a header.

priority.description: Evaluation order among guardrails, lowest first.
